name: Emami Paper Mills Limited
summary: Emami Paper Mills Limited manufactures and sells paper and paper board products in India. It offers packaging boards; and newsprint, writing, and printing papers, and kraft papers, as well as specialty papers. The company serves business-to-business customers consisting of front-line printers/converters, brands, end-use customers, Indian media houses, and retail and institutional consumers. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Kolkata, India.
